evidence.description: The userProfile observer posts notifications directly through NotificationCenter.default.
Authentication-state dispatch directly obtains EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager.shared and invokes its dispatchAuthState operation.

candidates.explanation: The authentication service directly accesses operational singleton services instead of receiving them through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The non-actor class exposes a globally accessible shared instance.
The shared instance holds mutable ID, access, refresh, and SSO credentials, along with mutable login status.
setupTokensWithCredentials writes the shared instance's token properties and login status without a visible isolation or synchronization boundary.

candidates.explanation: EcosiaAuthenticationService exposes mutable authentication state through its public static shared instance without visible actor isolation or synchronization. The immutable singleton reference does not protect the underlying instance properties.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
